credits: An original sketch. The Clerk, Margaret, Doreen and Nathan are fictional. The complaint is real and still under investigation; no individuals are named.
Facts: ATIA 16(2)(c); ZMap (2013) scans all IPv4 in under an hour; English Wikipedia hid logged-out editors' IPs from Nov. 4, 2025;
the Information Commissioner has had order-making power since 2019. Previously: 020 Privy Council
